clauses.statement: src/architecture-conformance.js must contain no raw 0x00 bytes; the matchedPatterns composite-key separator is expressed as the two-character escape sequence \0 in source, while the runtime key string still contains U+0000 between module name and pattern, so file(1) reports the file as text and plain grep matches its content.
clauses.rationale: Raw NUL bytes made the file binary to grep-based tooling and gates, which silently returned no matches; the \0 escape restores text-file status without changing runtime strings (AC-1, AC-2, AC-4).
